title: Assistant Accountant
description:
Assistant Accountant - Temp

Location: Glasgow
Salary: £32k (DOE)
Contract: Temp - 3mths
Working Pattern: Hybrid (2/3 days per week in office)
Benefits: Free Parking Great Working Environment Flexible Hybrid Working

We are delighted to be partnering with a leading public sector organisation based in Glasgow who are seeking an Assistant Accountant to join their finance team on a temporary basis.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a supportive organisation offering a fantastic working culture, strong team environment, and excellent employee benefits.

Ideally, you will be immediately available or on a short notice period.

Key Responsibilities:
- Maintain accurate financial records and support the integrity of the organisation's financial systems.
- Assist in the preparation of management accounts and financial reports.
- Manage and maintain the fixed asset register.
- Support payroll processes and ensure accuracy and compliance with relevant policies.
- Processing transactions through the group's financial ledgers.
- Completing and processing travel claims.
- Responsible for all Cash Book processing and daily to monthly bank reconciliations.
- Responsible for day-to-day credit control, monitoring overdue sales ledger invoices, sending out monthly customer statements, processing sales ledger journals and chasing overdue accounts.
- Responsible for banking and allocating all Head Office receipts.
- Responsible for processing of all purchase ledger invoices, including ensuring budget holders adhere to the purchase order procedures and reconciling suppliers' statements.
- Coordination and creation of weekly creditors payment runs for processing and review by the Financial Controller.
- Providing administrative support to the Financial Controller, Assistant Accountants and assisting the Finance team with other work/projects as appropriate/required.

Essential Experience & Skills:
- Proven experience within an accounting or finance environment, with sound record-keeping skills.
- Strong understanding of accounting processes
- Knowledge of payroll systems and procedures.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and general Microsoft Office applications.

Pertemps acts as both an employment business and an employment agency.

title: Claims Handler
description:
At Davies people are at the heart of all we do, out values state that we succeed together, and it is this, that makes the business a great place to work! You will be valued and supported and receive excellent benefits including but not limited to:
- Exclusive Rewards Platform - Enjoy discounts at over 800 retailers.
- Generous Holiday Allowance - Start with 25 days of holiday, in addition to UK bank holidays, with the potential to increase over time and the flexibility to buy up to 5 additional days per year.
- Professional Growth - Benefit from ongoing development opportunities, training programs, and support in obtaining professional qualifications.

Our Opportunity: 12 month fixed term contract

Davies is on the lookout for an experienced Claims Handler to enhance our growing Casualty team. This role offers a stimulating environment where the selected individual will be joining a committed team, providing a first-class proactive claims handling service to major clients.

We at Davies hold in high regard the transferable skills and attributes that you can contribute to the position. Although having a background in the industry is advantageous, it is not essential as we will provide you with full training and support when you start with us.

What will your day look like:
- Liaison: Communicate with insurers, policyholders, and brokers.
- Investigation: Handle allocated claims, either from your desk or by referring them to a field adjuster for on-site investigation when necessary.
- Evidence Gathering: Obtain all relevant evidence and documentation.
- Resolution: Determine appropriate actions to resolve each case.
- Reporting: Prepare detailed reports, advising on policy indemnity, legal liability, quantum, and tactics as needed.
- Negotiation: Negotiate settlements within agreed authority limits.
- Professional Correspondence: Maintain proactive communication with all parties involved.
- Adherence to Procedures: Handle cases according to documented procedures and client requirements.
- Reserve Management: Regularly review and maintain proper reserves.
- Continuous Learning: Stay updated on technical changes relevant to your role, including participating in company facilitated training programs.

Knowledge and Abilities:
- Proficiency in managing Claims from cradle to grave.
- Experience managing Property Claims.
- Experience with the investigation of Liability Claims.
- Knowledge of how to value injury claims.
- Understanding of Civil Procedure Rules and the Claims Portal.
- Commitment to delivering outstanding customer service.
- Collaborative team player.
- Management of personal caseload.
- Demonstrated adaptability and versatility.

Desirable:
- Experience in managing Employer's Liability (EL) & Public Liability (PL) claims.
- Familiarity with reserving strategies.
- Exceptional communication abilities across various levels.
- This role is tailored for individuals who are eager to apply their claim handling expertise and are ready to grow within a forward-thinking company. If you possess the essential skills and are looking for a challenging yet rewarding career, Davies welcomes your application.

Benefits

Career & Purpose
- Davies Innovation Lab
- Leadership training programme
- Funding for professional qualifications
- Thrive at Davies; learning opportunities

Environmental & Social
- The Davies Foundation
- Local charity funding
- Pennies To Heaven
- Employee Resource Groups
- Employee volunteering programme

Financial Health
- Pension, 5% employee and 5% employer contribution
- My Choices at Davies provides; High Street discounts and Financial wellbeing hub
- Life assurance: x 4
- Refer a Friend
- Cycle to Work Scheme
- Lease car salary sacrifice
- Davies Incentive Plan
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay

Mental, Physical & Emotional Wellbeing
- Wellbeing centre; move, munch, money & mind focus
- Discounts with 100's of UK retailers
- EAP; 24/7 confidential helpline
- 25 days holiday, increases to 26 days after 5 years and 27 after 10 years
- Flexible working
- Dress for your day
- Inclusive employment policies eg. Menopause, fostering friendly, fertility, sabbatical policy and baby loss and miscarriage

title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
This is a great time to join a growing Residential Conveyancing team in Glasgow.

Following continued growth and further expansion of the team, I am looking to speak with experienced Residential Conveyancing Paralegals who would like to join a firm that is genuinely going places, but which has retained a relaxed, supportive and very grown up approach to how people work.

For someone who enjoys managing their own caseload and wants the autonomy to get on with their job without being micromanaged, I think this is a particularly attractive opportunity.

You will manage your own residential conveyancing caseload from instruction through to completion, dealing directly with clients and taking ownership of your transactions. You will have experienced people around you when you need them, but equally you will be trusted to manage your workload and your clients in your own way.

What really stands out to me is the culture.

This is a supportive, friendly environment where people are treated like adults. There is good flexibility and, following an initial settling in period, the opportunity to work on a hybrid basis. Just as importantly, this is a firm that wants its people to develop and actively encourages progression and growth.

With the team continuing to expand, it is a really good time to come on board and be part of what they are building.

You should have at least a years experience managing your own residential conveyancing caseload and be comfortable handling transactions from start to finish.

Alongside a competitive salary, the firm offers good flexibility, private healthcare and a discretionary bonus.

If you are an experienced Residential Conveyancing Paralegal in Glasgow and would like to join a growing team where you will be trusted, supported and given the opportunity to develop, please get in touch with me for a confidential conversation.

title: Resourcing Coordinator (Maternity Cover)
company: Mission Aviation Fellowship UK - Agency - Permanent
description:
Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF) is seeking an organised and creative MAF in the Community (MiC) Resourcing Coordinator to support our vital resourcing and community fundraising work across the UK.

This is a rewarding opportunity for a dedicated administrator to use their skills to equip our staff, volunteers and church representatives, helping them inspire new donors and supporters to get behind our life-changing work.

Location: Folkestone or Glasgow (with hybrid working)

Contract: 12 month, fixed-term maternity contract

As an MAF in the Community (MiC) Resourcing Coordinator, you will support the day-to-day delivery of MiC UK's resourcing and community fundraising activities.

Working under the direction of the MiC Resourcing Lead, you will help develop and maintain engaging resources for churches, volunteers and other stakeholders, ensuring they have the materials and information they need to promote MAF and attract new donors and supporters.

You will also support the development of community fundraising plans, campaigns and supporter engagement, providing groups and individuals with resources and advice to help maximise fundraising income and attract new supporters.

Additionally, you will:
- Gather content for quarterly MiC Church newsletters
- Update volunteer, website, e-news and social media content
- Help develop new church and audience engagement resources
- Assist with the planning and delivery of MiC UK events
- Manage queries and meeting and speaking engagement paperwork

About You

To be considered as an MAF in the Community (MiC) Resourcing Coordinator, you will need:
- Experience in an administrative role
- Experience of working in an office environment
- Proficiency in Microsoft applications
- The ability to communicate positively, assertively and sensitively within a cross-functional team environment
- An efficient and organised approach
- The ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities
- Excellent attention to detail
- The ability to work on your own initiative
- Creativity and innovation
- At a minimum, A-levels or equivalent experience

About Us

Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF) is a Christian organisation that uses light aircraft to deliver practical help, physical healing and spiritual hope to some of the world's most remote and inaccessible communities.

For 80 years, MAF has been working in partnership with hundreds of other organisations to enable access to medical care, education, livelihood training and long-term support in over 24 low-income countries.

They believe that every community, however remote, should have access to the essentials of life - that's why MAF's flights are a lifeline, not a luxury.

The Benefits
- Salary of £28,701.28 per annum
- Annual leave entitlement of 22 days per year plus 8 paid public holidays per year
- Non-contributory pension scheme (10% of salary); employees may make voluntary additional contributions
- Death in service payment
- Flexible working policy
- Access to our Employee Assistance Programme

This is a rewarding opportunity for an organised administrator with experience to join our purpose-driven Christian organisation.

You'll enjoy a varied role spanning resourcing, community fundraising, events and communications, giving you the chance to broaden your experience, put your creativity to great use and develop a diverse range of skills.

Perhaps most rewarding of all, your work will help equip the people who champion MAF across the UK, supporting them to reach new audiences and inspire more people to get behind our life-changing work around the world.
